post.description: Authenticate with a Common Access Card or PIV certificate presented by the client. Establishes a session and reports whether legal-document acceptance is still required. CAC/PIV is a retired provider type: it is never offered on the sign-in screen, and this endpoint responds 501 unless the deployment both enables certificate sign-in and declares that a trusted proxy terminates mTLS and strips inbound certificate headers from client requests. The certificate details are read from request headers, so without that proxy there is nothing to authenticate on.

ScoreboardResponse.description:
Live scoreboard with weighted team rankings.

When scores are still private (judging not complete and scoreboard not
published) and the caller is not an event admin, ``rankings`` is empty and a
``message`` explains why; the score-bearing fields are then absent.

a rounds-enabled event replaces the flat ``rankings`` list
with ``groups`` (finalists first, then any cut groups, one capped
budget spanning the whole list); ``rankings`` is then absent, never
empty. A single-round event's response is unaffected — ``groups`` is
absent and ``rankings`` is exactly the legacy shape. Pre-reveal, when
the organizer has opted in and a round's down-select is confirmed,
the withheld-scores response additionally carries
``finalists_announced`` — team names only, no scores or ranks.

show_scoreboard.description: Whether the organizer has published the scoreboard. Reported even when scores are withheld so the event-home block can show a results-pending placeholder without revealing scores.

rankings.description: Legacy flat ranking list. Absent (not empty) on a rounds-enabled event.

groups.description: Capped, round-aware results list. Present only on a rounds-enabled event.

finalists_announced.description: Names-only pre-reveal finalist announcement. Present only in the withheld-scores response, only when the organizer opted in and a round's down-select is confirmed, and only before judging_complete.

message.description: Present only when scores are withheld from the caller.

ScoreboardResultsGroup.description:
One group of the capped, round-aware results list. The
first group is always ``kind='ranked'`` (the results round); any
further groups are ``kind='cut'``, latest round first.

D36 (supersedes D33's group presentation; D33's score redaction
stands) — for a non-manager (public) viewer, every ``kind='cut'``
group's team rows are reduced to an ALLOWLIST (security review M-1):
exactly ``team_id``, ``team_name``, ``round_id``, ``round_name`` and
the D36 continuation ``position`` — never a score/rank field and no
longer any project-enrichment field either. The rows arrive in the
published continuation order (later-cut rounds first, then
within-round rank) — the old neutral alphabetical re-sort is retired,
since the position is now public. Managers/admins receive the full
row shape documented on :class:`ScoreboardTeamRankingSerializer` for
every group, ranked included, with no ``position``.
